scope: SDR Gray/GrayAlpha animation; bounded jxl 0.8 adapter only
verification: Every native and EX RGBA16 sample equals independent libjxl reference; lossless source formulas also exact
Ordinary all-frame RGBA8 output exact after normalized rounding
sRGB all-frame output within one RGB8 unit; alpha exact
Source ICC is GRAY; RGBA output/reconstruction ICC is equivalent RGB neutral-axis profile
Arbitrary embedded Gray ICC rejected before init/draw on native, ordinary, EX and managed routes
Frame, animation-byte, expanded-byte, metadata-byte and pixel caps; every-byte truncation; trailing data; every native cancellation checkpoint; failure atomicity and recovery

render.inspection: All 12 decoded frame images inspected, neutral grayscale ramps/patterns and changing transparent samples readable without corruption; checkerboard only for visualization

benchmark_method: jpeg-xl-only release native API; 10 warmup decodes then five blocks of 200 decodes per case, Instant elapsed/200; includes full output allocation/drop; shared host
benchmark_caveat: These are new Gray cases, not a comparison against an unsupported baseline; existing RGB/XYB before-after regression benchmark is separate. No general speed claim.
